source_documents.purpose: Finding 7 and the deployment-only audit boundary.
Authoritative deployment preconditions and ordered design.
Exact Spain and Germany input contract.
Pinned worktree bytes that load separate hub defaults and secrets.
D8 SSH-side custody evidence underpinning the attestation-prep split.

scope_exclusions.reason: Store reviewer accounts and submission credentials are not production-server deployment inputs. The audit explicitly kept store readiness outside this finding.

workstation_observations.note: The file exists but its verdict is NO-GO, so it cannot supply final deployment authority.
Metadata only. Private key bytes and their digest are intentionally absent.
Entries exist for all three VPS addresses, but current provider-console observation and comparison are not proved.
Candidate only. The deploy brief forbids reuse until a fresh role-content audit separates public defaults from secrets.
Candidate only. Presence and mode do not establish role scope, freshness, or owner approval.
Candidate only. This file is not an approved production role input.
cloudflared was not found on PATH and was absent at this common owner-local location.
No authorized production gateway binary was found in the inspected workspace. This locator is reserved for later owner supply.

items.requirement: One final-audit GO report bound to an exact full post-fix Git SHA and the expected kernel releases for every target.
items.missing_reason: The latest located Daybreak Blue audit is NO-GO at the pre-RE-FIX-2 SHA and does not authorize that SHA or the merged RE-FIX-2 descendant.
items.required_action: Daybreak Blue must audit the exact clean post-RE-FIX-2 SHA and supply a GO report that names it.

items.requirement: Owner custody attestation for the existing deployment SSH identity, including owner-only metadata and a nonsecret public-key fingerprint.
required_evidence: private key path and safe metadata
items.missing_reason: Owner custody attestation not supplied. Lane-produced public fingerprint and safe metadata are staged in shared.ssh-identity-attestation-prep (pending supervisor binding and collector verification; no authority inferred); the owner countersign remains open.
items.required_action: Owner must supply the one-line deploy-key custody countersign. The prep item carries only public material and cannot satisfy this gate.

items.requirement: Fresh provider-console Ed25519 fingerprints for Kansas, Spain, and Germany compared with separately observed SSH keys and pinned known_hosts entries.
items.missing_reason: Known-host entries work, but current provider-console authority and the independent comparison are absent.
items.required_action: Verify each host in its provider console after the latest reimage and supply a comparison attestation.

items.requirement: Current out-of-band console access and recovery path custody for failures that remove SSH or require LUKS unlock.
items.missing_reason: No current console-access evidence was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must exercise or provider-confirm the out-of-band path and supply a secret-free attestation.

items.requirement: Audited public hub defaults with no populated secret-like assignment.
items.missing_reason: The located Kansas file is a mixed-role candidate and has not passed a fresh role-content audit.
items.required_action: Owner must produce a public-only defaults file and retain the role audit.

items.requirement: Audited control-role-only secrets file with no data-plane or core-role fan-out.
items.missing_reason: Candidate files exist, but role scope, freshness, and owner approval are unverified.
items.required_action: Owner must provide a freshly audited control-only secret file through the owner-controlled path.

items.requirement: Owner-only Spain defaults, Spain data-role secrets, forwarding Winn v3 config, and the exact cover, ECH, and distinct leaf material named by that config.
items.missing_reason: No approved Spain role-input envelope was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must assemble the role-scoped input directory under owner-only custody and bind its exact digest.

items.requirement: Owner-only Germany defaults, Germany data-role secrets, forwarding Winn v3 config, and distinct cover, ECH, and leaf material. Germany identity must not be guessed.
items.missing_reason: No approved Germany role-input envelope was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must approve Germany identity and assemble its owner-only role-input directory.

items.requirement: Aicore public defaults plus core-role-only secrets, including the exact LAN and dark-start declarations required by the brief.
items.missing_reason: No approved aicore role-input envelope was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must supply role-scoped defaults and secrets that pass the exact brief checks.

items.requirement: Owner-confirmed Kansas recovery point taken before installation.
items.missing_reason: No Kansas recovery-point attestation was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must create or confirm the recovery point and supply its secret-safe attestation.

items.requirement: Owner-confirmed Spain provider recovery point.
items.missing_reason: No Spain recovery-point attestation was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must create or confirm the recovery point and bind its attestation.

items.requirement: Owner-confirmed Germany provider recovery point.
items.missing_reason: No Germany recovery-point attestation was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must create or confirm the recovery point and bind its attestation.

items.requirement: Owner-confirmed recoverable aicore disk image or equivalent.
items.missing_reason: No aicore recovery attestation was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must establish a recoverable image and supply the attestation.

items.requirement: Approved unique Spain and Germany slugs, hostnames, public DNS, management names, hub URL, zone scope, public ports, Winn inner identities, non-overlapping forwarding /24s, and serving tiers.
items.missing_reason: No owner-approved node identity and network declaration was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must approve the complete per-node map in an external disclosure-controlled artifact.

items.requirement: Exact authorized linux/amd64 Winn v3 gateway executable named winn3-gateway.
items.missing_reason: No authorized production binary exists in the inspected workspace or located Mac candidates.
items.required_action: Retained authorized producer must supply the exact production binary.

items.requirement: Producer checksum file whose digest matches the exact binary and whose target name is winn3-gateway.
items.missing_reason: No approved checksum file was supplied.
items.required_action: Authorized producer must supply the checksum beside the exact binary.

items.requirement: Retained owner-authority producer receipt bound to the exact gateway binary, checksum, target, source SHA, and config contract.
items.missing_reason: No owner-authority producer receipt was supplied.
items.required_action: Authorized producer must issue and retain a digest-bound receipt.

items.requirement: Owner authorization for fresh per-node Winn v3 key generation and an owner-approved secret-store custody receipt. Proof-fleet keys are forbidden.
items.missing_reason: Fresh key generation is not authorized and no custody destination is attested.
items.required_action: Owner must authorize per-node generation and name the owner-controlled secret store.

items.requirement: Owner-only Cloudflare Access service-token environment file using the same hub-approved token pair.
required_evidence: hub token identity match without values
items.missing_reason: No approved management Access token file was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must provide the token file through owner custody. Never place token values in the evidence pack.

items.requirement: Absolute path and exact final-audit SHA-256 for the local cloudflared client.
items.missing_reason: cloudflared is absent from PATH on this Mac.
items.required_action: Final audit must approve exact client bytes, then the owner must bind that executable.

items.requirement: Approved Access policy, management names, node client digest, token expiry, HostKeyAlias binding, and a real headless Access SSH canary.
items.missing_reason: No approved policy and canary report was supplied.
items.required_action: Run the real headless canaries with the direct recovery path held open and retain a sanitized report.

items.requirement: Rehearsed Kansas LUKS unlock route plus FDE custody proof that final secrets are absent from provider and cloud-init data.
items.missing_reason: Fresh Kansas guest evidence passes the bounded LUKS-header, initramfs, named-path, guest-cloud-init, and local-snapshot checks, but the final custody receipt is absent, the legacy boot-chain entrypoint remains, and the credential transition, unlock rehearsal, and provider-control-plane boundaries are unverified.
items.required_action: Owner must authorize the legacy-entrypoint cleanup and Kansas unlock rehearsal, supply the historical conversion and production credential controls without exposing them, and obtain authenticated provider evidence for user-data disposition, snapshots and private images, the approved recovery point, and the console host fingerprint.

items.requirement: Rehearsed Spain LUKS unlock route plus FDE provider-residue and bootstrap-keyslot negative proof.
required_evidence: mapper keyslot kernel and time checks
final passphrase absent from provider and cloud-init
items.missing_reason: Fresh Spain guest evidence passes the bounded LUKS-header, initramfs, named-path, guest-cloud-init, and local-snapshot checks, but the final custody receipt is absent, the legacy boot-chain entrypoint remains, and the credential transition, unlock rehearsal, and provider-control-plane boundaries are unverified.
items.required_action: Owner must authorize the legacy-entrypoint cleanup and Spain unlock rehearsal, supply the historical conversion and production credential controls without exposing them, and obtain authenticated provider evidence for user-data disposition, snapshots and private images, the approved recovery point, and the console host fingerprint.

items.requirement: Explicit owner acceptance that substitute mode does not protect a powered-off, removed, or provider-snapshotted Germany disk.
items.missing_reason: No Germany substitute-disk acceptance was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must explicitly accept the named risk for Germany at the exact approved SHA.

items.requirement: Owner-approved hub and Cloudflare endpoints, Access policy, hidden-origin posture, and management-bootstrap route.
items.missing_reason: No owner-approved endpoint and Access declaration was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must approve the endpoint map and retain external hidden-origin and Access results.

items.requirement: Designated SMTP2GO test recipient and PayPal sandbox or separately approved non-chargeable test identity, plus product and webhook declarations.
items.missing_reason: No approved external test identities or receipts were supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must name safe test identities, run only non-chargeable checks, and retain sanitized receipts.

items.requirement: Approved backup destination and restore target plus Smart Router endpoint and HMAC authority with deterministic router-loss proof.
required_evidence: backup remote identity and restore receipt
items.missing_reason: No combined backup and router-authority evidence was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must bind the external services and retain restore plus deterministic fallback evidence.

items.requirement: Owner-approved aicore core ID, public ingress and stealth endpoints, hub binding, real LAN CIDR, and dark-start posture.
items.missing_reason: No approved aicore identity and endpoint declaration was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must approve the exact core identity and endpoint map.

items.requirement: Same-SHA PASS report for canonical HMAC and replay controls, Bearer rejection, adjudicated routing policy, bounded vLLM-death fallback, SITE_AI, Hoppy, and public origin protection.
items.missing_reason: The RE-FIX-2 router report proves the local-provider dependency repair at its branch SHA, but no same-merged-SHA report yet covers the full canonical HMAC, replay, Bearer rejection, routing-policy, SITE_AI, Hoppy, public-origin, and live AICORE requirement.
items.required_action: The router reconciliation or merge lane must produce a complete same-merged-SHA PASS report, and the final audit must independently verify it with compatible-target evidence.

items.requirement: Physical UPS, reserve, BIOS power recovery, watchdog, cooling, dust, fan, thermal, NVMe, power, health, and alert proof with owner-approved acceptance thresholds.
items.missing_reason: No physical aicore power and cooling report was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must run the physical tests, set thresholds before results, and retain a PASS or FAIL report.

items.requirement: Wired DHCP reservation and external TCP 80 plus UDP 9210 forwarding proof for aicore, with Wi-Fi disabled.
items.missing_reason: No WAN, DHCP, and external forwarding report was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner and external tester must exercise both protocols from outside the LAN and retain the sanitized report.

items.requirement: Explicit owner acceptance that aicore substitute mode does not protect a powered-off, removed, or snapshotted root disk.
items.missing_reason: No aicore substitute-disk acceptance was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must explicitly accept the named risk at the exact approved SHA.

items.requirement: Owner-approved future UTC bridge expiry that causes de-advertisement and cannot self-extend.
items.missing_reason: No owner-recorded bridge expiry was supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must set a bounded UTC expiry and attest the fail-closed expiry behavior.

items.requirement: Bounded plan and evidence path for the required B exit: off-box x86 builds and an audited gx10 router deployment.
items.missing_reason: No complete B-exit evidence plan or qualifying artifacts were supplied.
items.required_action: Owner must name the off-box builder and retain each gx10 qualification artifact before the bridge expires.

items.requirement: Authorized external test-client and per-node direct AWG, Winn v3 carriage, DNS, egress-country, leak, kill-switch, failure, reboot, and frozen promotion evidence.
items.missing_reason: No external carriage or promotion evidence exists before deployment.
items.required_action: External tester must run the full per-node gate while nodes remain dark and freeze the evidence before promotion.

items.requirement: Authorized synthetic-client two-hop carriage, DNS, egress, leak, kill-switch, AI-failure, 30-minute contention, reboot, and evidence-digest-bound core promotion proof.
required_evidence: promotion receipt bound to evidence SHA-256
items.missing_reason: No aicore carriage or promotion evidence exists before deployment.
items.required_action: External tester must run the full gate while the core remains dark and freeze the evidence before Kansas promotion.

items.requirement: Same-SHA hub PASS before data, Spain and Germany PASS before aicore, and the required secret-free Opus counsel plus Sol decisions at each go/no-go point.
items.missing_reason: The three RE-FIX-2 source-fix reports exist, but they are not the ordered same-approved-SHA hub, data-plane, and AICORE deployment authority reports required by this item.
items.required_action: After a final-audit GO names an approved SHA, each deployment lane must produce its ordered report at that same SHA with the required secret-free Opus counsel and Sol decision.

items.requirement: Lane-produced public fingerprint and safe metadata for the existing deployment SSH identity; contains no secret material and confers no custody.
items.missing_reason: Public material staged in the tree but unverified: the manifest carries no evidence record by design. Supervisor binding plus collector-produced evidence (collect_path stats the live bytes and CONFLICTs on digest mismatch) is pending. No owner input required for this item.
items.required_action: Supervisor binds this item to the staged file at collect time so the collector produces the evidence record from the live bytes. The owner countersign in shared.ssh-identity-custody remains independently open.
